data.body:
[P2] Establish evidence for the engine-specific lexical assumptions

Rule 6, “Mark unverified assumptions,” requires evidence for external behavior or an explicit unverified designation. These exemptions depend on Athena and DynamoDB tokenizing backslashes as assumed, but the description reports a real-engine check only for PostgreSQL. The new allow-tests exercise this validator, not either database, so they cannot establish that agreement. Return to the design phase under Rule 8 and document evidence for the engine assumptions, or mark them unverified for a maintainer decision.
